lines.text: At the start of Zedekiah's reign, the LORD told Jeremiah to make a yoke and send word to five kings.
The LORD said He made the earth and has placed all these lands under Pharaoh Neco king of Egypt.
The LORD said He would punish any nation refusing Babylon's yoke, and that the prophets telling them otherwise were prophesying a lie.
Jeremiah told Zedekiah to put his neck under Babylon's yoke and live, because the LORD had not sent the prophets.
The articles left in Jerusalem, which Nebuchadnezzar did not take when he exiled Hezekiah son of Ahaz, will be carried to Egypt.
